lifecycle.footer: You get these tips because you created a ContractOS account.

welcome.subject: Welcome to ContractOS
welcome.heading: Your first lease in 10 minutes
welcome.body2: ContractOS drafts Puerto Rico leases, sends them for signature from any phone and reminds you before they expire.
welcome.body3: Start by adding a property; the lease takes a few minutes after that.

first_property.subject: Add your first property
first_property.heading: Add your first property
first_property.body1: With the address and units on file, your leases fill themselves in.
first_property.body2: Have several? Import an Excel or Google Sheets file in one step.

first_contract.subject: Draft your first lease
first_contract.heading: Draft your first lease
first_contract.body1: The builder follows Puerto Rico's 2020 Civil Code and covers the deposit, late fees and your own clauses.
first_contract.body2: You can save a draft and finish it later.

esign.subject: Sign without printing
esign.heading: Let your tenant sign from their phone
esign.body1: Send the lease for signature: your tenant gets a link, confirms who they are with a code and signs. No account needed.
esign.body2: Once everyone signs, you get the sealed PDF with its signing certificate.
